name: Rahul
role: Founder of Remedy. Appears in some @remedyrecoveries carousels (about 1 in 4), never all.
identity_source: real/ only. Real photos of Rahul (OneDrive, Nov 1). Never use a generated image of him as a reference.

look.face: long oval face, elongated midface, lean cheeks, defined but not square jaw, rounded chin
look.brows: thick near-black, mostly straight, natural asymmetry
look.eyes: dark-brown almond, slightly heavy upper lids
look.nose: long and prominent, straight-to-slightly-convex bridge, rounded tip
look.mouth: thinner upper lip, fuller lower lip
look.skin: medium warm-brown, olive undertones, real texture, faint under-eye darkness
look.facial_hair: short uneven stubble, never a full beard, never clean-shaven
look.build: lean athletic, moderate shoulders, narrow waist

hair_states.compact: curls kept compact, pushed mostly off the forehead
hair_states.defined: defined curls, a few ringlets on the forehead
hair_states.tousled: high-volume messy waves and curls, flyaways
hair_states.hero-curl: swept loosely back, one curl dropping onto the forehead
hair_states.side-shift: curl mass shifted to one side

rules: Same hair and outfit inside one carousel; vary both across carousels.
Reject a shot if the nose is shortened, the jaw squared, the face rounded, the skin airbrushed, the curls made uniform, or he looks like a model.
Do not copy a reference photo's room or pose; only his face, hair texture and build.
